request.spec:
The remainder of a pool's cuts now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, the latest
added on a tie (a member with no cut gets none; a pool with no non-zero cut gives it to the last
member with a share).

agent.result_text:
A pool's leftover cents now go to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, and all 4 acceptance tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

The change is in the `cuts()` function in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/pools/pools.ts`. I didn't change anything on the server or in the stored data, because pool cuts are worked out only on the front end.

How the remainder is now handed out:
- **Usual case:** it goes to the member whose cut is the smallest above zero. If two members tie, it goes to the one added later. Before, it went to the member with the largest share, and the earlier one won a tie.
- **No cut above zero:** it goes to the last member who still has a share above zero and isn't left out. A member is left out if they're retired, on hold, or their dates don't cover the sheet's today.
- **Left-out members:** they still never receive any of the remainder.

If the remainder is negative because the rounded cuts add up to more than the pot, the same member gives up the cent. That is why, in the test's 0.02 pot, Cam ends up at 0.00. I also updated the comment above the function to describe the new rule.
